purpose: Manually reviewed subset of visually recognizable candidates. This is not a complete atlas classification.
notes: Coordinates are inherited from atlas_catalog.json and refer to original 1536x1024 PNG files.
Composite atlas entries contain multiple objects and must be split before use as individual sprites.
Some visually recognizable objects may still have imperfect candidate bounds; inspect the source crop before wiring into the game.
Only this subset was manually classified; all other candidates remain unclassified.
